items.title: Edgar "Sambo" Joseph Interview, 1960-08-07
items.q: He called Mrs. So-and-so, Mrs. Robert, or Mrs. Joan, or Mrs. Williams, and Mr. Williams.

ctx.x: Man, that's a wonderful thing to see. What was the idea of them marching around the hall like that?

Well the idea, I tell you. You see, that's when they call it a call out. They be calling out the members for the guests. First what they do, all members is taking part in a dance. If you belong to the organization, they got a man with a book. He called Mrs. So-and-so, Mrs. Robert, or Mrs. Joan, or Mrs. Williams, and Mr. Williams. Well the ladies, there's 20 ladies, or 20 men, or 40 men, and 40 ladies. The ladies stand on one side. What you take and do them, when they call your name, they call the man's name…
Does all these lodges do that?
